title: DexDeployment
description: One deployed instance of one DEX protocol on one chain: the (protocol, chain, factory) triple that a pool's address is scoped by. ABSENT TODAY: no table, no adapter and no route produce a deployment; the plan's §4 freeze lists it and nothing implements it. It is a SEPARATE entity from Protocol on purpose - Uniswap v3 exists on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum as three deployments with three factory addresses, three subgraph endpoints and three fee-tier sets, and collapsing them into one Protocol row is what makes a cross-chain pool join silently wrong. A pool may not be stored without its deployment_id once deployments exist; until then pool.json carries the provider's dex_id string.

factory_address.description: The factory contract pools are discovered from; null when the DEX has no factory (orderbook-style venues).

amm_family.description: The AMM family (plan §20), which decides which parser applies - not the protocol name.

active.description: False for a deployment that has been deprecated or whose chain has halted. A consumer MUST NOT silently substitute another deployment.
